question: Accept this backlog seed into ideation: make the FO binary-absent install hint channel-aware so an edge plugin stops hinting the stable binary its own version gate rejects?

artifacts.summary: Follow-up to install-sh-edge-prerelease-parity (#756): the skill-first journey's install hint (shared-core binary-absent line + fo-install-gate.md) is channel-blind - an edge install is sent to plain brew or channel-less curl, landing stable v0.26.0 that the minor-0.27 pin then aborts. Seed names three candidate channel-detection signals for ideation (host plugin-install record, per-channel skill stamp, minor-pin-as-proxy) and notes macOS has no edge cask so SPACEDOCK_CHANNEL=edge curl is the only edge remedy on both OSes. Delivery will stack on the #756 branch (the env var ships there). Coordinates with d2k (upgrade journey) and xw (binary-absent harness).
